title: Keep heavy state out of global data
summary: Per-call state lives server-side keyed by call_id. Only a count and the distinct areas go to global_data, and the handlers read the full record from the store.
scenario: A mechanic phoning in a bike inspection, one finding at a time

folds: #7 (state held across turns without the model tracking it)
#19 (the dealer cannot be talked out of a bust)
evidence: demo goair state_store.py:1-6, README Per-Call Dynamic Config
